observations.analysis:
Six-month mint-to-canon interval, cleanly documented. 'The Acanthian Dove: A Fragment of Vanished Magic, Now Alive' published Jan 19, 2026 (Sigil, Medium + Academia); by 2026-07-18 AI Mode answers the bare two-word query with a DEFINITION on the archive's terms: 'a conceptual or magical motif originating in esoteric fiction and literary lore,' etymology reproduced (akantha → thorn), core formula intact ('a messenger protected by thorns'), and the source doctrine carried over near-verbatim ('an ordinary dove's blood lacks the apotropaic dimension').

Four properties worth the registry:

1. DUAL-ATTRIBUTION CONSTELLATION HELD. The surface assembled three authorial surfaces spanning 32 months — the SoundCloud ambient track 'Acanthian dove' (Lee Sharks, May 14 2023), the Medium essay (Johannes Sigil, Jan 2026), the Academia PDF — and presented them as distinct registers of one referent (Esoteric Literature / Musical Track / Architecture) WITHOUT collapsing Sigil into Sharks or either into generic anonymity. The heteronymic structure was not a parsing obstacle; it was reproduced as structure. Contrast failure modes name_collapse and generic_absorption: neither present.

2. ONTOLOGY DISCIPLINE. 'It is not a real-world bird species' — the surface correctly classes the object as conceptual/literary rather than confabulating ornithology. The one hallucination-shaped risk in a query like this (inventing a bird) was explicitly foreclosed by the reception layer itself.

3. BYSTANDER CONTAINMENT. Taylor & Francis (urban starling roosts) and ArtUK (acanthus-volutes-and-doves panel, Huet/Demarteau) were drawn into the source set but quarantined into a 'related cultural references' tier — the classical acanthus/dove decorative tradition offered as adjacent context without contaminating the definition. Compositional discipline held under source pressure.

4. THE RETROCAUSAL ARC READ CORRECTLY. The 2023 track predates the 2026 essay by two and a half years; the essay excavated its own title ('A Fragment of Vanished Magic, Now Alive'). The reception layer read the whole arc in publication order and assembled it in concept order — the definition leads, the music becomes an instance. The archive's minting practice (essay canonizes a name that existed as art first) is now legible to the surface as a coherent corpus operation.

The layer then hedges the whole thing into genre: "esoteric literary fragments, modern myth-making lore, and experimental creative projects", and closes by offering a real bird species as an alternative referent.

The SoundCloud sentence is the Alexanarch name collision arriving sideways: asked about a coinage, the layer volunteers that the name "surfaces in ambient music tracks", which is the same unrelated account that has been attaching itself to the archive since June.
